text:
rebecca (PM): quick follow-up from the all-hands. partners want a single-line flight plan for API -> Console -> Optimize with owners, canary runway, and any doc/SKD freezes. can we lock it here?

trung (CTO): high-level: API first -> Console after API stability -> Optimize beta overlapping Console stabilization. keep canaries short and staggered. owners: API=mia, Console=ash, Optimize=rebecca.

mia (Eng): API canary plan: canary runway 36h, start at 2% traffic (`--canary --pct 2`), run smoke tests and alert watch, expand to 15% if healthy, then 7-day observation before GA. will attach runbook link to ticket.

ash (DevEx): doc impact: avoid breaking SDK signatures. any new Optimize params must be optional; SDK minor bump only. propose doc freeze 72h before API GA. I'll schedule a 25-min partners webinar within 48h of GA.

nora (Security): telemetry policy: Private deployments telemetry = off by default. we'll provide a telemetry dataflow diagram and an opt-in UI. will complete security checklist before Console canary.

rebecca (PM): Console notes: need a tiny API endpoint to surface dedicated pool sizes for the dashboard. Console canary = 72h after parity branch merged; feature-flag gating (`enable_for_beta`) for new Console features.

ops-bot: Canary scheduled: api-service v2.7.0 -> 2% -> 2026-01-10T15:00:00Z

trung (CTO): infra: confirm autoscale flags exist (`--dedicated=true --autoscale-min --autoscale-max`). will add GET /internal/pools to return current sizes for Console.

mia (Eng): will not introduce call-signature changes. token rotation/migration for SDK noted — will publish migration guide prior to GA.

ash (DevEx): action items: I'll open SDK changelog PR, draft partner note, and book webinar. please tag me on canary ticket with final start time.

rebecca (PM): summary for posting: API (owner mia) -> 36h canary -> 7-day observation -> GA. Console (owner ash) -> parity -> 72h canary behind `enable_for_beta` -> GA. Optimize (owner rebecca) -> rolling beta cohorts starting during Console stabilization; telemetry opt-out for Private. owners will get calendar invites and runbook links.

notifier-bot: Reminder: add postmortem link to canary ticket template.

trung (CTO): +1. keep canaries staggered by at least 48h. thanks all.
